from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,json,time,concurrent.futures
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');a=s/'unsafe-code-candidate'
e=dict(os.environ,PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH='/usr/bin/chromium',EKA2L1_WASM_BUILD_DIR=str(a),EKA2L1_AOT_IR_MODE='7',EKA2L1_AOT_EAGER_REGIONS='0',EKA2L1_TLB_HASH='1',EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1',EKA2L1_BENCHMARK_AOT='5',EKA2L1_AOT_VERIFY='0',EKA2L1_CODE_COMPARE='2',EKA2L1_CODE_LOOKUP='0',EKA2L1_EXECUTION_LIMITS='512,16,8,512',EKA2L1_PREDICATED_LEAVES='1',EKA2L1_EXIT_CENSUS='0',EKA2L1_LEAF_FEATURES='0')
for k in ['LD_LIBRARY_PATH','EKA2L1_CODE_WRITE_PROTECT','EKA2L1_GUEST_PROFILE','EKA2L1_AOT_DIAGNOSTICS']:e.pop(k,None)
def phase(name,**kw):
 (s/'unsafe-attribution-acceptance-state.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(phase=name,utc=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),**kw),indent=2)+'\n');print(name,kw,flush=True)
def run(args,name,cwd=r,env=e):
 with(s/name).open('w')as log:subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=3600)
 print(name+' PASS',flush=True)
def faults(mode):
 run(['python3','src/tests/benchmark/run_cpu_fault_matrix.py',str(a),str(s/f'unsafe-attribution-fault-{mode}'),'--ir-policy','7','--code-compare','2','--tlb-hash','1','--execution-limits','512,16,8,512','--predicated-leaves','1','--exit-census','0','--leaf-features','0','--unsafe-code',str(mode)],f'unsafe-attribution-fault-{mode}.log')
try:
 assert json.loads((s/'unsafe-code-finish-state.json').read_text())['phase']=='full_mode_timings_complete_attribution_review_pending'
 phase('component_faults_parallel_not_timing')
 with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2)as pool:
  pending=[pool.submit(faults,mode)for mode in [1,2]]
  for future in pending:future.result()
 for scene in ['standard','long']:
  frames,start,route=(1600,21000000,'snakes.input')if scene=='standard'else(360,42000000,'snakes-length-long.input')
  ref=s/('merge-20260930-native/run-0/frames'if scene=='standard'else'merge-20260930-long-native/run-0/frames')
  for mode in [1,2]:
   phase('component_replay',scene=scene,mode=mode);out=s/f'unsafe-attribution-replay-{scene}-{mode}'
   run(['node','benchmark.ts',str(s/'assets'),str(out),str(frames),str(r/'src/tests/benchmark'/route),str(start)],f'unsafe-attribution-replay-{scene}-{mode}.log',r/'src/tests/wasm',dict(e,EKA2L1_UNSAFE_CODE=str(mode)))
   run(['python3','src/tests/benchmark/compare.py',str(ref),str(out)],f'unsafe-attribution-compare-{scene}-{mode}.json')
   c=json.loads((s/f'unsafe-attribution-compare-{scene}-{mode}.json').read_text());q=json.loads((out/'report.json').read_text());assert c['match']and c['frames']==frames and q['start_us']==start and q['unsafe_code']==mode and q['verify_aot']==0
 phase('accepted')
except Exception as error:phase('failure',error=str(error));raise

from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,json,sys
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');a=s/'unsafe-code-candidate';baseline=s/'predicated-leaf-candidate'
scene,batch=sys.argv[1:];assert scene in ('long','standard') and batch in ('a','b')
start,end,route=(42000000,60000000,'snakes-length-long.input')if scene=='long'else(60000000,78000000,'snakes.input')
order={'a':['control','scan','guards','unsafe'],'b':['guards','unsafe','control','scan']}[batch]
args=['python3','src/tests/benchmark/serial_variants.py',str(s/'assets'),str(s/f'unsafe-attribution-timing-{scene}-{batch}')]+[f'{n}={baseline if n=="baseline" else a}'for n in order]
for name in order:
 mode={'control':0,'scan':1,'guards':2,'unsafe':3}[name]
 for option,value in [('ir-mode','7'),('eager-regions','0'),('tlb-hash','1'),('code-compare','2'),('code-lookup','0'),('execution-limits','512,16,8,512'),('unsafe-code',str(mode)),('predicated-leaves','1'),('leaf-features','0'),('input',str(r/'src/tests/benchmark'/route))]:args.extend(['--'+option,f'{name}={value}'])
args+=['--start-us',str(start),'--end-us',str(end)]
subprocess.run(args,cwd=r,env=dict(os.environ,EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1'),check=True)
rows=json.loads((s/f'unsafe-attribution-timing-{scene}-{batch}/measurements.json').read_text());assert len(rows)==8
assert len({tuple(x['measurement'][k]for k in ['first_instructions','last_instructions','presentations'])for x in rows})==1
print(scene,batch,'identical guest work verified',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,statistics,subprocess,sys
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');d=r/'src/tests/benchmark';stage=sys.argv[1];assert stage in ('acceptance','timings')
p=d/'UNSAFE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_EVIDENCE.json'
e=json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else {'archive':json.loads((s/'unsafe-code-candidate/source.json').read_text()),'full_experiment':'UNSAFE_CODE_RESULTS.md / UNSAFE_CODE_EVIDENCE.json','modes':{'0':'exact control','1':'skip primary and dependency byte scans only','2':'omit generated code-write guards and entry-proof code-overlap tests only','3':'both; no mutation tracking'},'harness':{}}
for name in ['unsafe_attribution_acceptance.py','run_unsafe_attribution_timing.py','guarded_unsafe_attribution_timings.py','record_unsafe_attribution.py']:
 f=s/name;e['harness'][name]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source':f.read_text()}
report=d/'UNSAFE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_RESULTS.md'
if stage=='acceptance':
 assert json.loads((s/'unsafe-attribution-acceptance-state.json').read_text())['phase']=='accepted'
 for name,sha in e['archive']['files'].items():assert hashlib.sha256((s/'unsafe-code-candidate'/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha
 e['acceptance']={'faults':{},'replays':{}}
 for mode in [1,2]:
  f=json.loads((s/f'unsafe-attribution-fault-{mode}/summary.json').read_text());assert f['completed_cases']==40640
  assert all(x['all_fields_match']==x['cases'] for x in f['results'])
  logs=list((Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark')/f'unsafe-attribution-fault-{mode}').glob('*-wasm.log'));assert logs
  for log in logs:assert log.read_text().splitlines()[0]==f'PROBE_UNSAFE_CODE {mode}'
  e['acceptance']['faults'][str(mode)]=f
  for scene,frames,start in [('standard',1600,21000000),('long',360,42000000)]:
   comparison=json.loads((s/f'unsafe-attribution-compare-{scene}-{mode}.json').read_text());q=json.loads((s/f'unsafe-attribution-replay-{scene}-{mode}/report.json').read_text())
   assert comparison['match'] and comparison['frames']==frames and q['unsafe_code']==mode and q['verify_aot']==0 and q['start_us']==start
   assert q['ir_mode']==7 and q['execution_limits']==[512,16,8,512] and q['predicated_leaves']==1 and q['leaf_features']==0 and q['exit_census']==0
   assert comparison['audio']['sample_frames']==(4656051 if scene=='standard' else 2832756)
   assert q['wasm_sha256']==e['archive']['files']['eka2l1.wasm'] and q['loader_sha256']==e['archive']['files']['eka2l1.js']
   e['acceptance']['replays'][f'{scene}-{mode}']={'comparison':comparison,'report':q}
 e['status']='Component faults and exact replays pass; serial attribution timings pending.'
 report.write_text('''# Unsafe code-mutation cost attribution

This follows the completed fully unsafe / matching-control / untouched-live comparison in UNSAFE_CODE_RESULTS.md. The same frozen archive is used; no compiler, scheduling, source/leaf/site/runner limit or guest-work change is introduced.

Modes: 0 exact control; 1 scan removal only; 2 generated code-write guard and entry-proof code-overlap removal only; 3 both. The archive has version, epoch and write-protection options disabled in every mode. These are deliberately unsafe diagnostics, OFF by default. No deployment or push.

Modes 1 and 2 each pass 40,640 explicitly selected native fault comparisons and exact standard (1,600 images) / longer (360 images) native image, guest-record and PCM replays. Actual-mode readback, correct capture starts and verify_aot=0 are checked. The 175-test suite and mode 0/3 acceptance are reused from the same archive; they are not fresh runs. Intentional stale-code counterexamples remain documented in the full experiment. Replay does not prove no code mutations occur.

The fixed serial plan contains 32 observations: four same-binary modes, both routes, two orders followed by their reversals. Batch A is control/scan/guards/unsafe and reverse; B is guards/unsafe/control/scan and reverse. Thus each mode moves between inner and outer positions. All observations and passive host readings are retained. The untouched live archive was measured in the preceding full-mode comparison, not this attribution panel. Performance counters are disabled during timing; zero counter fields are not mutation or invalidation evidence. Component changes need not be additive because emitted code and browser optimization can interact.

Timing is pending.
''')
else:
 assert json.loads((s/'unsafe-attribution-timing-state.json').read_text())['phase']=='all_timing_complete'
 e['timing']={};text='\n## Serial timings\n\nSeconds for identical guest work within each route, lower is faster. All 32 samples remain.\n\n| Route/batch | Exact | Scan removal | Guard removal | Both |\n| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |\n';detail=''
 for scene,batch in [('long','a'),('long','b'),('standard','a'),('standard','b')]:
  rows=json.loads((s/f'unsafe-attribution-timing-{scene}-{batch}/measurements.json').read_text());host=json.loads((s/f'unsafe-attribution-timing-{scene}-{batch}-host.json').read_text());assert len(rows)==8 and host['returncode']==0
  assert len({tuple(x['measurement'][k]for k in ['first_instructions','last_instructions','presentations'])for x in rows})==1
  values={};means={}
  for name,mode in [('control',0),('scan',1),('guards',2),('unsafe',3)]:
   selected=[x for x in rows if x['name'].rsplit('-',1)[0]==name];assert len(selected)==2
   for row in selected:assert row['unsafe_code']==mode and row['ir_mode']==7 and row['predicated_leaves']==1 and row['leaf_features']==0 and row['execution_limits']==[512,16,8,512]
   values[name]=[x['measurement']['wall_seconds']for x in selected];means[name]=statistics.mean(values[name])
  e['timing'][f'{scene}-{batch}']={'rows':rows,'means':means,'host':host}
  text+=f"| {scene} {batch} | {means['control']:.4f} | {means['scan']:.4f} | {means['guards']:.4f} | {means['unsafe']:.4f} |\n"
  detail+=f'\n{scene} {batch}: '
  for name in ['scan','guards','unsafe']:
   pairs=[100*(c/u-1)for c,u in zip(values['control'],values[name])]
   detail+=f"{name} {100*(means['control']/means[name]-1):+.2f}% throughput versus exact, corresponding-half pairs {pairs[0]:+.2f}% / {pairs[1]:+.2f}%; "
  detail+='\n'
 text+='\n'+detail+'\nCorresponding-half pairs are not all adjacent. No samples are filtered or normalized; host readings do not establish causes of individual slow observations. Interpret the per-batch and paired results before pooled averages. This experiment deliberately breaks self-modifying-code semantics and is not a deployable optimization.\n'
 report.write_text(report.read_text().split('\n## Serial timings')[0].replace('\nTiming is pending.\n','\n')+text)
 e['status']='All 32 serial component observations retained; interpretation recorded separately; modes remain disabled by default and unserved.'
p.write_text(json.dumps(e,indent=2)+'\n')
subprocess.run(['git','add',str(p),str(report)],cwd=r,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','Record unsafe code-mutation attribution '+stage],cwd=r,check=True)
